hot_threads.topic: 2024 robotic vacuum cleaner selection and brand comparison
hot_threads.thread_summary: The original post presents a comprehensive 2024 robotic vacuum cleaner comparison video covering 5 major brands and 17 models, analyzing features like sweeping, mopping, edge cleaning, navigation, obstacle avoidance, base stations, and smart features. The community reaction reveals significant consumer frustration: 1) Users express exhaustion with the complex research required for purchases in China, comparing it to medical decisions. 2) Multiple brands (specifically mentioned: Roborock, Dreame, Ecovacs) receive complaints about poor after-sales service and product reliability. 3) Consumers criticize brands for intentionally withholding features to drive incremental upgrades, similar to smartphone marketing. 4) There's widespread skepticism toward influencer recommendations due to perceived excessive marketing and fake reviews. 5) Users report difficulty choosing despite comparisons, as all brands seem to have negative feedback. 6) Some share personal negative experiences with specific high-end models failing quickly. 7) Others mention positive resolution experiences (like refunds) but still seek alternatives. 8) The overall sentiment suggests consumers rely more on personal research and peer recommendations than professional reviews.
